newsitem.title: USA: Invivo says new product sales on target.
newsitem.headline: Invivo says new product sales on target.

text.p: Invivo Corp, a maker of medical instruments, said Thursday the launch and initial sales of its new portable vital signs monitor called Millenia are on target with the company's plan.
"We expect Millenia to contribute to higher revenue and earnings for Invivo beginning in the current quarter," Chief Executive Officer James Hawkins said in a statement.
Invivo's shares were up one to 12-1/4 by mid-afternoon.
Earlier, the company reported fiscal 1997 first quarter net income of $3,000, or nil per share, versus $820,000, or $0.24 a share one year ago.
Selling, general and administrative costs rose more than 50 percent to $3.3 million from $2.1 million in the year ago quarter due to Millenia's launch.
"Current and potential customers are responding enthusiastically to (Millenia)," Hawkins said.
He said the company is continuing to expand its sales force and hopes to have a total of around 30 in the near future.
